body.statement:
For every finite-rational, finite-discrete ordinary full-kernel instance \(\mathcal D_{\mathrm{ord}}\in\mathfrak D_{\mathrm{AEK}}\), use the all-cells single-world translation.  Every ordinary full-kernel identifying collection \(\mathbf B=(B_1,\ldots,B_t)\) yields an accepted switching certificate \(E_{\mathbf B}\) with
\[
 \operatorname{Cost}(E_{\mathbf B})
 =\sum_{B\in\{B_1,\ldots,B_t\}_{\mathrm{distinct}}}
   \sum_{v\in B}\kappa_v.
\]
Conversely, every accepted switching certificate in \(\iota(\mathcal D_{\mathrm{ord}})\) yields, after adding missing zero-cost READ actions and coalescing equal RAND-endpoint sets, an ordinary full-kernel identifying collection \(\mathbf B(E_{\mathrm{sw}})\) whose cost is at most \(\operatorname{Cost}(E_{\mathrm{sw}})\).  Hence the ordinary and embedded operational problems have the same feasibility status and optimum cost.  Under the convention that the ordinary-law oracle is part of the input interface and its response length is charged by \(N_{\mathcal O}\) rather than expanded in the structural reduction, NP-hardness and the published \((1-o(1))\ln|V|\) polynomial-time inapproximability transfer to this SELECT--RAND--READ image.  They do not transfer an action-level approximation guarantee to the general physical catalogue.
body.justification: The corrected two-way map matches the published all-cells target and preserves optimum cost after READ coalescing.
body.gap: A fixed intervention cell cannot support a claimed equivalence with the published full-kernel ordinary design problem.
body.consumer: Ordinary NP-hardness and logarithmic inapproximability transfer exactly on the SELECT--RAND--READ oracle image.
body.proof_tex:
Fix \(\mathcal D_{\mathrm{ord}}\in\mathfrak D_{\mathrm{AEK}}\).  For \(B\subseteq V\), the protocol
\[
 S_B=\{s\}\cup\{r_v:v\in B\}\cup\{\rho_v:v\in V\}
\tag{1}
\]
has exactly one fresh-unit SELECT, uses each mechanism at most once, is precedence closed and conflict free, and satisfies the stipulated ordinary physical compatibility.  Hence \(S_B\in\Pi\).  Independence and uniformity of its RAND coordinates give, for every \(b\in\mathfrak X_B\),
\[
 \Pr\{R_B=b\}=\prod_{v\in B}|\mathfrak X_v|^{-1}>0.
\tag{2}
\]
By the all-cells translation and the label-slice definition,
\[
 \operatorname{Slice}(S_B,\ell_{B,b})
 =P_b(V\setminus B)
 =Q[V\setminus B](\cdot;b).
\tag{3}
\]
Every vertex is READ, so measured ancestry holds.

Let \(\mathbf B\) be ordinary full-kernel identifying.  Equations (2)--(3) show that the acquired source collection is exactly the translated family \(\mathcal Q_{\mathbf B}\), for every intervention assignment and every outcome cell.  Lemma \(\mathrm{Single\mbox{-}world\ operational\ specialization}\) makes the complete translated run accept.  The switching normal form chooses one successful source for every branch; paid markers retain any acquired protocol not chosen by a branch.  SELECT and READ cost zero, so
\[
 \begin{aligned}
 \operatorname{Cost}(E_{\mathbf B})
 &=\sum_{B\in\{B_1,\ldots,B_t\}_{\mathrm{distinct}}}
   \sum_{v\in B}c(r_v)\\
 &=\sum_{B\in\{B_1,\ldots,B_t\}_{\mathrm{distinct}}}
   \sum_{v\in B}\kappa_v.
 \end{aligned}
\tag{4}
\]

Conversely, let \(E_{\mathrm{sw}}\) be accepted in the embedded catalogue, and put
\[
 B(S)=\{v:r_v\in S\}.
\tag{5}
\]
Adding missing zero-cost READ actions preserves SELECT cardinality, mechanism use, precedence, conflicts, physical compatibility, and cost.  Coalesce protocols having the same set (5).  It remains to show that every used slice is available from the complete ordinary family belonging to these sets.

Suppose a label fixes RAND coordinates \(D\subseteq B(S)\) at \(b_D\), leaves \(B(S)\setminus D\) unconditioned, and asserts a READ event \(R=r\).  For any recorded event \(A\), independence and uniformity of RAND labels give
\[
 \Pr_S(A\mid R_D=b_D,R=r)
 =
 \frac{
 \displaystyle\sum_{b_{B(S)\setminus D}}
 \left(\prod_{v\in B(S)\setminus D}|\mathfrak X_v|^{-1}\right)
 P_{(b_D,b_{B(S)\setminus D})}(A,R=r)}{
 \displaystyle\sum_{b_{B(S)\setminus D}}
 \left(\prod_{v\in B(S)\setminus D}|\mathfrak X_v|^{-1}\right)
 P_{(b_D,b_{B(S)\setminus D})}(R=r)}.
\tag{6}
\]
The denominator is positive exactly because the accepted record passes the positive-source-event check.  Equation (6) uses no positivity for an unasserted READ cell.  It expresses the used slice as a finite rational operation on the all-assignment members of \(\mathcal Q_{\mathbf B(E_{\mathrm{sw}})}\).  Marginal source factors extracted from that slice are therefore available from the same family.  Substituting (6) into each finite accepted branch computation, and applying the single-world specialization lemma, yields ordinary operational acceptance for every intervention-assignment and outcome cell of the full kernel.  Thus \(\mathbf B(E_{\mathrm{sw}})\) is ordinary full-kernel identifying in the stated operational sense.

With \(w(B)=\sum_{v\in B}\kappa_v\), coalescing equal endpoint sets and the zero costs of SELECT and READ give
\[
 \sum_{B\in\mathbf B(E_{\mathrm{sw}})}w(B)
 \le
 \sum_{S\in\operatorname{Prot}(E_{\mathrm{sw}})}w(B(S))
 =\operatorname{Cost}(E_{\mathrm{sw}}).
\tag{7}
\]
The inequality may be strict when two READ masks have the same RAND endpoints.  If \(\operatorname{Opt}_{\mathrm{ord}}\) is the ordinary optimum, (4) implies \(\operatorname{Opt}_{\mathrm{sw}}\le\operatorname{Opt}_{\mathrm{ord}}\), while (7) implies the reverse inequality.  The same maps in the absence of a feasible design prove equality of feasibility status.

The published ordinary full-kernel hardness lemma applies to the finite-discrete, finite-rational class just used.  Equations (4) and (7) are a two-way cost-preserving reduction, so an exact or \(\rho\)-approximate algorithm on the embedded image would give one with no larger cost or approximation ratio for the ordinary problem.  NP-hardness and the \((1-o(1))\ln|V|\) threshold therefore transfer.  The structural map writes only the graph, catalogue, costs, and oracle signature in polynomial time; the ordinary law and support table remain oracle responses whose actually returned bits are charged by \(N_{\mathcal O}\).  This is the stated oracle representation convention.  The proof uses only SELECT--RAND--READ protocols and therefore supplies no action-cover approximation for catalogues with CTF-RAND, partial-child actions, precedence conflicts, or cross-action synergy.
